```{r}

trait_dataset$scientificName %>%
  sort()

trait_dataset %>% 
  filter(traitName %in% c("dielVerticalMigration",
                          "verticalDistribution")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName == "Euphausia pacifica")




species <- c(
  "Acartia longiremis", "Aetideus divergens", "Calanus pacificus", "Calliopius pacificus", 
  "Centropages abdominalis", "Clione limacina", "Clytia gregaria", "Corycaeus anglicus", 
  "Cyphocaris challengeri", "Discoconchoecia elegans", "Eucalanus bungii", "Euphausia pacifica", 
  "Eutonina indicans", "Metridia pacifica", "Microcalanus pygmaeus", "Mitrocoma cellularia", 
  "Muggiaea atlantica", "Munida quadrispina", "Nanomia bijuga", "Neocalanus plumchrus", 
  "Oithona atlantica", "Paracalanus parvus", "Paraeuchaeta elongata", "Pasiphaea pacifica", 
  "Pseudocalanus mimus", "Pseudocalanus minutus", "Pseudocalanus newmani", "Scina borealis", 
  "Thysanoessa longipes", "Triconia borealis"
)


trait_dataset %>%
  filter(traitName %in% c("dielVerticalMigration",
                          "verticalDistribution")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% species) %>% 
  select(scientificName, traitName, traitValue, primaryReference, primaryReference, primaryReferenceDOI, secondaryReferenceDOI) %>%
  write_csv("Data_output/Vertical_Distribution.csv")


trait_dataset %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% "Beroe")

DVM <- trait_dataset %>%
  filter(traitName %in% c("dielVerticalMigration")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% species) %>% 
  select(scientificName, DVM = traitValue, DVM_ref = primaryReference)

Dist <- trait_dataset %>%
  filter(traitName %in% c("verticalDistribution")) %>% 
  filter(scientificName %in% species) %>% 
  select(scientificName, Distributiion = traitValue, Distributiion_ref = primaryReference)

full_join(DVM, Dist) %>% 
  write_csv("Data_output/Vertical_Distribution.csv")

```
